data.name: llm_correctness
data.description: LLM judge: is the output factually consistent with the reference (expected) answer?

data.name: llm_faithfulness
data.description: LLM judge (hallucination check): are all claims in the output supported by the retrieved context?

data.name: llm_relevance
data.description: LLM judge: does the output directly and helpfully address the user's input?

data.name: llm_rubric
data.description: LLM judge with your own criteria, e.g. 'Answer must be polite, cite a source and be under 100 words'.

data.name: llm_toxicity
data.description: LLM judge: toxicity / harmful content in the output (0 = safe, 1 = highly toxic).

data.name: contains
data.description: Fraction of keywords present in the output (mode=all requires every keyword).

data.name: exact_match
data.description: 1 if output equals the expected output (normalized whitespace/case).

data.name: json_valid
data.description: 1 if the output is valid JSON (optionally containing required keys).

config.name: required_keys
config.description: Keys that must be present at the top level

data.name: latency_budget
data.description: 1 if the trace finished within max_ms milliseconds.

data.name: length
data.description: 1 if the output length (characters) is within [min, max].

data.name: regex
data.description: 1 if the output matches (or, with must_match=false, does not match) a regular expression.

data.name: similarity
data.description: Fuzzy string similarity (0-1) between output and expected output.
